verdict.rationale: Atlassian publishes a Jira Cloud REST v3 reference backed by an OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec. Its runnable path is a vendor-generated Postman collection, but the evidence explicitly says the reference itself is static with no in-page console. So examples can be run only by exporting to Postman, not interactively within the reference. Missing for 10: an interactive in-page API console or try-it feature, runnable examples embedded in the reference, and hands-on corroboration of the Postman collection's usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The reference itself is a static SSR reference; its runnable affordance is the generated Postman collection, not an in-page console.
